scope: Independent audit of the current HUD-discovery spike, based on the Claude conversation and a snapshot of the production Python sources. No production files were edited.

highest_priority.title: Negative-control scoring accepts false detections and rejects correct empty output
highest_priority.reproduction: Truth events={} and groups=[] returns exit 1. The same truth with a nonempty detected group returns exit 0.
highest_priority.impact: The verifier cannot establish the claimed no-event behavior. Separately, direct recomputation confirms that the existing Doom clip currently yields zero groups.
highest_priority.suggested_fix: Handle empty truth explicitly: pass exactly when no groups are detected. Retain a positive-event regression test.

highest_priority.title: Clip identity collisions overwrite output and permit samples from another input
highest_priority.reproduction: Batch match.avi and match.mp4: the two index entries point to one output directory. Discover match.avi with --reuse-samples then loads metadata and arrays from match.mp4.
highest_priority.impact: Detections can belong to different footage than the requested video; real-resolution exemplars can also be mixed with the wrong sampled timeline.
highest_priority.suggested_fix: Give each input an unambiguous cache identity and validate the source fingerprint and sampling settings before reuse.

highest_priority.title: Rejected candidates consume all available group slots
highest_priority.reproduction: Twenty-four larger, inconsistent-duration candidates precede a smaller valid event. The default limit returns zero confirmed events; changing the limit from 24 to 25 recovers the valid event.
highest_priority.impact: Clutter can hide real HUD events even though every earlier candidate is later rejected.
highest_priority.suggested_fix: Apply the output-group cap after validation, or keep scanning candidates until the confirmed-group budget or separate work budget is reached.

highest_priority.title: Minecraft truth can attribute another player's death or lose deaths after midnight
highest_priority.reproduction: Local player Alex incorrectly includes Alexander's death. A video starting at 00:00:10 with log lines spanning 23:59:50 to 00:00:30 misses the death expected at +20 seconds.
highest_priority.impact: The reference labels can be wrong, corrupting recall and precision estimates.
highest_priority.suggested_fix: Match the complete player token and anchor the log date consistently when the recording starts after midnight.

other_reproduced_findings.finding: The standalone draft profile omits the letterbox crop transform while storing geometry normalized to the cropped frame.
Greedy nearest-onset matching reports one match where a valid assignment has two: truth=[2,3], found=[1,2.4], tolerance=1.1.
An occurrence reaching the final sample is shortened by one sample interval: 2 seconds becomes 1.5 seconds at 2 fps.
Writing a new profile with no detectors leaves an older templates.npz archive in the output directory; this is output hygiene rather than a demonstrated runtime failure.

validation_boundary: Recomputing from the saved sample stacks reproduces synthetic death and kill F1=1.00, round F1=0.86, one unmatched group, and zero Doom groups. This validates those particular results. No positive detection result on real gameplay from multiple games is present; adaptability, live overhead, and overlay behavior remain unproven.
parallel_work_split: Claude can continue the production implementation while this audit directory holds isolated validation fixtures and regression checks. Production fixes should be coordinated to avoid concurrent edits.
